# Carzio — Car rental in Agadir, Morocco

> Carzio is an independent car rental agency based in Agadir, Morocco. It rents recent cars with unlimited mileage, standard insurance included, no security deposit, free cancellation up to 24 hours before pickup and payment at key handover. Pickup is available at Agadir Al Massira airport and at the agency.

## Key facts

- Address: MAG N2, Agadir Airport, Morocco.
- Phone and WhatsApp: +212 680 318003.
- Email: contact@carzio.ma.
- Website: https://www.carzio.ma.
- Opening hours: 24/7 at Agadir Al Massira airport (other pickups on request or at agency hours).
- Minimum rental: 3 days (72 hours), billed in 24-hour blocks; any started day is charged in full.
- Driver requirements: minimum age 23 and driving licence held for at least 4 years, for every car. No young-driver surcharge.
- Second driver: free, same requirements.
- Baby seat and booster: free, on request.
- Security deposit: 0 MAD. No card hold. Debit cards accepted.
- Payment: at key handover, by bank card.
- Cancellation: free up to 24 hours before pickup.
- Fuel policy: return the car at the same fuel level.
- Insurance: standard insurance is included (glass, tyres and mirrors covered). Full Risk insurance reduces the excess to 0 MAD for +€10/day or +€15/day depending on the vehicle. Full Risk is available from 5 billed days only, is never pre-selected and is removed automatically below 5 billed days. Its price is included in the total shown before confirmation.
- Delivery: free at Agadir Al Massira airport and at the Agadir agency. Marrakech and Casablanca: €80 per trip (delivery and, if applicable, return). Taghazout, Tamraght and Essaouira: on request, price confirmed before booking.
- Fleet: 12 cars, economy to SUV, good prices for our clients. Some models have GPS and a touchscreen.
- Languages: French, English, German, Spanish and Polish on the website. Articles are published in French and English.
